اجتلين (form VIII)
# اِجْتَلَيْنَ (ijtalayna) /id͡ʒ.ta.laj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
# اُجْتُلِينَ (ujtulīna) /ud͡ʒ.tu.liː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
# اِجْتَلِينَ (ijtalīna) /id͡ʒ.ta.liː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
